name: Eldrazi Stompy
notes: Faithful 60-card Legacy colorless Eldrazi Stompy. Sol-land acceleration (Ancient Tomb/City of Traitors) into oversized Eldrazi + Chalice prison. ENGINE-RISK (faithful, no-compromise build): Thought-Knot Seer / Reality Smasher / Matter Reshaper have cast/death triggers; Eldrazi Mimic & Endless One are */* with ETB choices; Chalice of the Void uses X; Walking Ballista and Umezawa's Jitte are counter/equipment artifacts; Warping Wail is modal. CP7 mostly jams creatures, ignoring the Chalice-lock plan.
